problem_statement: The accepted Collin source contract identifies a PACS Access export containing current and certified value families in the same physical row, but the exploratory decoder is evidence rather than production code and did not independently establish exact signed, scaled, and multiword NUMERIC behavior. No county adapter is currently production-ready. [source_id: a8d0164e015d086c00140812] [source_id: 05e1317dff1c2a0b0cdc4827]
desired_outcome: Create a synthetic-only, adapter-local Collin foundation that exactly decodes the approved 17-byte NUMERIC wrapper, validates the privacy-minimized AD_Public structure, parses typed Collin source records, and emits separate immutable current and certified observations with exact provenance. The change must preserve physical source grain while excluding acquisition, persistence, publication, orchestration, owner data, production Access runtime selection, and production-ready status. [source_id: 3321aaed641cd22210fac979] [source_id: be2861af666dfc3b02456915] [source_id: c3dd5eb82533bab379d6af62] [source_id: 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416]
assumptions: Caller-supplied release identifiers and source-member identifiers are available to the adapter and are not inferred from row content. [source_id: c3dd5eb82533bab379d6af62]

The implementation can use Python standard-library Decimal, hashing, JSON, and immutable typed records without adding a production Access reader or another dependency. [source_id: 3321aaed641cd22210fac979] [source_id: 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416]

Fixtures can be independently authored, synthetic, identity-free, checksum-documented, and distributed under the repository's synthetic-fixture licensing boundary. [source_id: 7676ed46a8bb877ba7fdaac0] [source_id: 05e1317dff1c2a0b0cdc4827]

planning_decisions.decision_text: Support only the observed 17-byte NUMERIC wrapper: byte zero is the canonical sign marker; the remaining sixteen bytes contain four little-endian 32-bit magnitude words ordered most-significant word first; external precision and scale metadata control exact Decimal construction. Precision is 1 through 28, scale is 0 through precision, overflow and negative zero are rejected, and independently authored literals cover zero, signed, scaled, multiword, boundary, year, and monetary cases without a mirrored encoder.

Validate exactly the AD_Public table and the approved privacy-minimized identity, status, year, current-value, and certified-value columns. Bind required columns by exact case-sensitive name; reject missing or incompatible required structure, duplicate names, case-fold collisions, aliases, positional binding, and unexpected tables. Additional column descriptors participate in the canonical schema fingerprint and produce a warning, but their values are never read or retained.

Emit one current observation classified by the exact trimmed property_status and a separate certified observation when the certified family is consistently populated. Preserve family, source year, source-column lineage, schema fingerprint, parser contract version, release identifier, source member, table, and one-based row provenance. Current and certified observations remain separate even when their years and values match.

Enforce the approved prop_id, geo_id, status, nullability, year, monetary, diagnostic, privacy, and exact-value rules. Confine implementation to the Collin adapter, adapter-local tests and fixtures, and directly related source documentation. Do not define production release processing, shared vendor-neutral source-record, provenance, native-value, or streaming abstractions, or Collin DAG integration because those areas belong to Issue 43.

boundary: Issue 43 owns the production release-processing API and bounded streaming boundary. [source_id: 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416]
Issue 43 owns shared vendor-neutral source-record, provenance, and native-value abstractions. [source_id: 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416]
Issue 43 owns Collin DAG integration; Issue 18 must remain a synthetic adapter-local foundation and must not enter these areas. [source_id: 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416]

task_slices.title: Define Collin physical contracts and independent fixtures
task_slices.description: Add adapter-local physical descriptors, diagnostic codes, immutable contract types, and reviewed literal NUMERIC vectors for D1, D2, and D4. Fixtures must be synthetic, identity-free, checksum-documented, and authored independently of the decoder.

task_slices.title: Implement exact NUMERIC decoding and schema validation
task_slices.description: Implement the D1 exact Decimal decoder and D2 AD_Public descriptor validation, including canonical schema fingerprinting, stable structural diagnostics, metadata checks, and fail-closed behavior using the independent fixtures from task 1.1.

task_slices.title: Implement typed Collin rows and dual-roll observations
task_slices.description: Implement D2 through D4 source-row parsing, identifier, status, year, nullability, and monetary validation, then convert valid physical rows into separate immutable current and certified observations with exact provenance and no deduplication.

task_slices.title: Add negative, privacy, and contract coverage
task_slices.description: Extend adapter-local tests and fixtures with malformed NUMERIC, schema-drift, lexical, null-consistency, repeated-row, provenance, privacy-redaction, no-float, no-owner-field, and package-boundary cases for the implementation from task 3.1.

task_slices.title: Document the Collin decoder foundation
task_slices.description: Document the implemented D1 through D4 wrapper layout, structural contract, dual-roll semantics, provenance, diagnostics, privacy boundary, resource assumptions, synthetic-fixture provenance, unresolved account identity, Issue 43 ownership, and explicit non-production compatibility limit.

requirements.title: Exact decoding of the bounded NUMERIC wrapper
requirements.normative_rule: The Collin adapter MUST decode only the approved 17-byte NUMERIC wrapper into an exact Decimal using the canonical sign byte, four little-endian 32-bit magnitude words in most-significant-word-first order, and externally supplied precision and scale. It MUST return the exact reviewed value and MUST NOT use binary floating point, silent rounding, or a fixture encoder that mirrors the decoder.

scenarios.name: Decode an independent signed multiword vector
given: an independently authored 17-byte signed multiword NUMERIC literal
reviewed precision and scale metadata
a reviewed exact negative Decimal answer
scenarios.when: the adapter decodes the literal and metadata successfully is required to yield the reviewed exact negative Decimal without float conversion or silent rounding.
then: The exact reviewed negative Decimal value is returned.
The declared precision and scale are retained in the decoded representation.
No binary floating-point conversion or silent rounding occurs.

scenarios.name: Decode independent year vectors
given: independently authored 17-byte literals for 2025 and 2026
precision metadata admitting both values
scale metadata equal to zero
scenarios.when: the adapter decodes each literal successfully is required to yield exact Decimal values 2025 and 2026 from fixtures not generated by a shared encoder.
then: The first literal yields the exact Decimal value 2025.
The second literal yields the exact Decimal value 2026.
The vectors are independent of the decoder implementation.

requirements.title: Deterministic rejection of invalid numeric values
requirements.normative_rule: The Collin adapter MUST reject non-bytes values, widths other than 17 bytes, unsupported sign markers, missing or invalid precision and scale, precision overflow, negative zero, non-integral or out-of-range years, and negative or oversized appraisal monetary values with stable diagnostic codes. A malformed non-null numeric value MUST NOT become None or a partial accepted record.

scenarios.name: Reject numeric precision overflow
given: a non-null 17-byte buffer whose magnitude exceeds its declared precision
otherwise valid field and row metadata
scenarios.when: the adapter decodes the numeric field successfully is required to fail with numeric_precision_overflow and return no Decimal or accepted source record.
then: Decoding fails with numeric_precision_overflow.
No Decimal or partial accepted source record is returned.
The non-null malformed value is not converted to None.

scenarios.name: Reject a negative appraisal amount
given: a valid signed NUMERIC literal representing a negative value
a Collin appraisal monetary field descriptor
scenarios.when: the adapter validates the decoded monetary field successfully is required to fail with invalid_monetary_value without emitting an observation or exposing the source value.
then: Validation fails with invalid_monetary_value.
No logical observation is emitted.
The diagnostic does not contain the source value.

scenarios.name: Reject an invalid source year
given: a valid scale-zero NUMERIC literal representing 2101
a current-year field descriptor
scenarios.when: the adapter validates the decoded year successfully is required to fail deterministically with invalid_value_year and emit no current observation.
then: Validation fails with invalid_value_year.
No current observation is emitted.
Repeated evaluation produces the same failure code.

requirements.title: Fail-closed structural validation and fingerprinting
requirements.normative_rule: The Collin adapter MUST bind the approved privacy-minimized projection by exact case-sensitive column name, validate the required AD_Public table and every required physical descriptor independently of the fingerprint, and fail before row conversion on missing, duplicate, colliding, renamed, unsupported, or incompatible required structure or an unexpected table. It MUST allow safe extra column descriptors only as fingerprinted metadata, report extra_columns_present, and never read their values.

scenarios.name: Accept reordered required columns with safe extras
given: one AD_Public descriptor set containing every required compatible column
required columns in a different order
one additional non-required column descriptor
scenarios.when: the adapter validates the observed structure successfully is required to bind by exact name, fingerprint every descriptor, report extra_columns_present, and avoid reading the additional value.
then: Required fields bind by exact case-sensitive name rather than position.
A deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint covers every observed descriptor.
extra_columns_present is reported without reading or retaining the additional column value.

scenarios.name: Reject a case-fold column collision
given: an AD_Public descriptor set containing geo_id and GEO_ID
all other required descriptors in compatible form
scenarios.when: the adapter validates the descriptor set successfully is required to fail with column_name_collision and unsupported_schema before row conversion.
then: Validation fails with column_name_collision.
unsupported_schema is reported.
Row conversion does not begin.

scenarios.name: Reject an unexpected table
given: metadata containing AD_Public and a second table
otherwise compatible AD_Public descriptors
scenarios.when: the adapter validates the table set successfully is required to fail with unexpected_table and emit no source records.
then: Validation fails with unexpected_table.
The schema is classified as unsupported.
No source rows are converted.

requirements.title: Typed identity, status, and null handling
requirements.normative_rule: The Collin adapter MUST preserve prop_id as a non-boolean integer from 1 through 2147483647, preserve a validated ASCII-trimmed geo_id without equating it to prop_id, accept only trimmed Preliminary, InProgress, or Certified property_status values, and enforce the approved required and nullable field relationships. It MUST reject inconsistent certified-family nulls without copying values between families.

scenarios.name: Preserve distinct Collin source identifiers
given: a synthetic row with prop_id 42
a geo_id of 00042-A surrounded by ASCII spaces
property_status equal to Preliminary
scenarios.when: the adapter parses the row successfully is required to preserve prop_id as 42 and geo_id as 00042-A as distinct source fields without creating an account-key claim.
then: prop_id is retained as integer 42.
geo_id is retained as 00042-A.
No canonical account-key claim is created.

scenarios.name: Reject boolean property identity
given: a synthetic row whose prop_id value is true
otherwise valid required fields
scenarios.when: the adapter parses the row successfully is required to fail with invalid_prop_id and not treat the boolean as integer 1.
then: Parsing fails with invalid_prop_id.
No typed source record is returned.
The boolean is not accepted as integer 1.

scenarios.name: Reject inconsistent certified nulls
given: a synthetic row with null cert_val_yr
one non-null certified value
scenarios.when: the adapter validates certified-family nullability successfully is required to fail with inconsistent_certified_family and emit no certified observation.
then: Validation fails with inconsistent_certified_family.
No certified observation is emitted.
The non-null certified value is not copied to the current family.

requirements.title: Separate immutable current and certified observations
requirements.normative_rule: The Collin adapter MUST emit current and certified value families as separate immutable adapter-local observations with their own source family, source year, classification, exact source-column lineage, release and row provenance. It MUST NOT merge, overwrite, suppress, infer, or fill one family from the other, even when their years and values match.

scenarios.name: Emit two observations from one physical row
given: a synthetic AD_Public row with current year 2026 and InProgress status
populated current values
certified year 2025 and populated certified values
caller-supplied release and source-member identifiers
scenarios.when: the adapter converts the row successfully is required to emit an InProgress current observation for 2026 and a separate certified observation for 2025 with exact column and row provenance.
then: One current observation classified as InProgress and year 2026 is emitted.
One separate certified observation classified as certified and year 2025 is emitted.
Both observations retain exact source-column and one-based row provenance.

scenarios.name: Omit an absent certified family
given: a valid synthetic row with null cert_val_yr
all certified values null
a populated valid current family
scenarios.when: the adapter converts the row successfully is required to emit only the current observation without inferred certified values.
then: One current observation is emitted.
No certified observation is emitted.
No certified value is inferred from the current family.

scenarios.name: Keep matching families separate
given: a valid synthetic row whose current and certified years and exact values match
scenarios.when: the adapter converts the row successfully is required to emit two distinct observations whose identities differ by source family.
then: Two distinct observations are emitted.
Their identities differ by source family.
Neither observation replaces or fills the other.

requirements.title: Physical source grain and privacy-safe diagnostics
requirements.normative_rule: The Collin adapter MUST preserve every physical row and its prop_id and geo_id fields without deduplication, account roll-up, owner-association inference, or protected-identity reconstruction. Diagnostics MUST contain only an approved stable code, field or table name, one-based row number, and schema fingerprint, and MUST NOT include complete rows, arbitrary source values, credentials, host paths, owner data, or addresses.

scenarios.name: Preserve repeated physical rows
given: two synthetic rows with the same prop_id and geo_id
different one-based physical row numbers
otherwise valid value families
scenarios.when: the adapter converts both rows successfully is required to retain two records with distinct row provenance and perform no roll-up or deduplication.
then: Two typed source records are retained.
Each record retains its own one-based physical row number.
No account roll-up or deduplication occurs.

scenarios.name: Redact malformed-row diagnostics
given: a synthetic row containing an invalid geo_id
sentinel owner, address, credential, and host-path strings outside the approved projection
scenarios.when: the adapter reports the validation failure successfully is required to return invalid_geo_id with bounded provenance and none of the sentinel values or complete row.
then: The diagnostic code is invalid_geo_id.
Only approved bounded provenance fields may accompany the code.
No sentinel value or complete row appears in the diagnostic.

requirements.title: Bounded non-production foundation
requirements.normative_rule: This change MUST remain an adapter-local synthetic contract foundation and MUST NOT add network access, county artifacts, an Access database or runtime dependency, production acquisition, services, DAGs, persistence, migrations, Bronze or Gold behavior, publication, deployment, owner publication, shared vendor abstractions, or a production-ready designation.

scenarios.name: Enforce the completed change boundary
given: the implementation diff for the accepted change
the declared adapter, adapter-test, fixture, and source-documentation paths
scenarios.when: the trusted implementation path policy evaluates the diff successfully is required to find every changed file within scope and no prohibited runtime, data, dependency, persistence, orchestration, publication, or deployment change.
then: Every changed file is within the declared implementation scope.
No county artifact, production record, Access runtime, or new dependency is added.
No service, DAG, persistence, publication, workflow, policy, infrastructure, or deployment path changes.
The Collin adapter remains explicitly non-production.

risks: The approved 17-byte wrapper is specific to the measured pure-Python reader and may not match a future production Access runtime representation; the physical contract must be narrowly named and versioned, and a future runtime must verify its emitted bytes or introduce a separately reviewed contract. [source_id: 3321aaed641cd22210fac979]

Synthetic fixtures establish deterministic behavior but do not prove compatibility or performance against a live Collin release; the adapter must remain non-production until separate source-record verification and benchmarking are accepted. [source_id: a8d0164e015d086c00140812] [source_id: 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416]

Additional schema columns may contain sensitive or unreviewed facts; only descriptors may enter the fingerprint, and extra-column values must never be read, retained, diagnosed, or published. [source_id: be2861af666dfc3b02456915]

Repeated prop_id and geo_id values could be misinterpreted as approved account identity; every physical row must remain distinct and no account key or roll-up may be claimed. [source_id: c3dd5eb82533bab379d6af62] [source_id: a8d0164e015d086c00140812]
security_privacy_considerations: The approved projection excludes owner, DBA, mailing, and situs values, and the adapter must never read those fields into typed records, fixtures, diagnostics, or extras. [source_id: be2861af666dfc3b02456915]

Diagnostics are restricted to stable codes and bounded structural provenance; complete rows, arbitrary values, credentials, host paths, protected identities, owner data, and addresses are prohibited. [source_id: 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416]
Only small synthetic or independently redistribution-safe fixtures may be committed; full county releases and protected owner data are prohibited. [source_id: 7676ed46a8bb877ba7fdaac0]
Owner and mailing-address publication remains default-deny, and protected identities must never be reconstructed. [source_id: a8d0164e015d086c00140812]
migration_compatibility_concerns: No data migration or backfill is authorized or required because this is additive, adapter-local, synthetic-only work with no persistence or stored release schema. [source_id: 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416]

Rollback consists of reverting the adapter-local decoder, contract types, tests, synthetic fixtures, and bounded source document; no database, Bronze artifact, or Gold product requires repair. [source_id: 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416]

Compatibility is limited to the versioned 17-byte wrapper and bounded AD_Public projection. A future runtime, source substitution, production release API, shared record abstraction, or Collin DAG requires separately accepted work. [source_id: 3321aaed641cd22210fac979] [source_id: 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416]
non_goals: Live Collin discovery, source contact, HTTP probing, download, ZIP extraction, or Access container handling. [source_id: 515a41057d446a949cae5adc]
Selection, installation, or approval of a production Access runtime or a new dependency. [source_id: 3321aaed641cd22210fac979] [source_id: 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416]
Texas Open Data substitution or migration. [source_id: a8d0164e015d086c00140812]

Approval of prop_id, geo_id, or another value as a canonical account key; owner-association deduplication or account roll-up. [source_id: c3dd5eb82533bab379d6af62] [source_id: 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416]
Vendor-neutral shared source-record, provenance, native-value, release-processing, or streaming contracts owned by Issue 43. [source_id: 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416]

Domain or application model changes, services, Airflow orchestration, persistence, database migrations, Bronze loading, Gold publication, APIs, workflows, policy, infrastructure, deployment, or production configuration. [source_id: 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416]

Owner or mailing-address ingestion or publication, protected-identity reconstruction, or a production-ready designation. [source_id: be2861af666dfc3b02456915] [source_id: 8230e8434d4ed3576ea75416] [source_id: 05e1317dff1c2a0b0cdc4827]

evidence_citations.excerpt: Supported buffer width: exactly 17 bytes. Byte order: each of the four 32-bit magnitude words is little-endian. Word order: the four words are ordered most-significant word first.
Required table: exactly `AD_Public`. Additional tables are unsupported.
Current and certified observations SHALL be separate immutable records even when their years or values match.
The decoder remains a synthetic, adapter-local contract foundation; any future shared record type or bounded streaming boundary is owned by #43.
The artifact contains current and certified field families in the same row.
`collin-cad-source-contract`: Evidence-backed Collin PACS Access export discovery, remote-probe, dual-roll, numeric-decoding, identity, and privacy behavior.
Status: repository scaffold and initial OpenSpec are complete; no county adapter is production-ready yet.
The initial human approval rule is an authorized maintainer merging the planning PR.
Allowed dependency direction: `dags/services -> adapters -> application -> domain`.
Adapters translate external formats and implement ports; source-specific fields stop at this boundary.
Commit only small synthetic or redistribution-safe fixtures. Document their source layout and checksum; never commit full county releases or protected owner data.
Run `make docs` after changing maintained Markdown.
Requirements use SHALL/MUST and four-hash `#### Scenario` headings with WHEN/THEN steps.
Use synthetic or independently redistribution-safe fixtures only.
